_comment: Regulatory deadlines shown on the home page. Every entry needs a citation to a named instrument and article, verified against the Official Journal text, not a secondary source. The _verify fields are working notes and are NOT rendered; a deadline whose _verify records an open question has not been checked, and an unchecked deadline must not ship. Only obligations that are law belong here: a Commission working plan is not law and carries no date, so it is described in prose on the page instead (2026-09-25).

deadlines.title: Unsold goods
deadlines.summary: Destroying unsold textiles and footwear is banned for large companies, and what they discard must be disclosed.
deadlines._verify: Confirmed: Art. 25; large companies from 19 Jul 2026; medium-sized from 19 Jul 2030; micro/small exempt. Destruction exceptions in Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/296. Disclosure is Art. 24.

deadlines.title: Battery passports
deadlines.summary: Every battery in scope placed on the EU market or put into service needs a battery passport: an electronic record for that individual battery.
deadlines._verify: Art. 77(1) verified verbatim against the consolidated OJ text 02023R1542-20250731 on 2026-09-25: from 18 Feb 2027, each LMT battery, each industrial battery above 2 kWh and each EV battery placed on the market or put into service shall have an electronic record ('battery passport'). The earlier 'registered in the EU central registry' clause was removed: Art. 77 does not say it.
